title: `supplyCollateral` Does Not Accrue Interest — Combined with `borrow`/`withdraw` Ordering Can Allow Fresh Collateral to Mask Stale Debt Health Check Timing
impact: `supplyCollateral` deliberately skips `_accrueInterest` to save gas. This is safe in isolation because no debt-impacting value is read there. However, it means `position[id][onBehalf].collateral` can be topped up while `market[id].totalBorrowAssets` is stale; the subsequent `borrow` or `withdrawCollateral` call does accrue before `_isHealthy`, so the ordering is correct. The residual risk is a **read-only reentrancy / view inconsistency**: any external `view` reading `position` + `market` via `extSloads` or public getters between transactions observes an inconsistent debt/collateral snapshot if a callback (e.g., in a `supply` callback flow) queries health. Integrators reading `isHealthy` mid-callback may get stale debt figures.
